verdict.rationale: Luma documents a public API through docs.lumalabs.ai. The documentation covers API key creation on the platform, Python/JS/TS SDKs, generation and reasoning endpoints, credit pricing, an llms.txt index and markdown versions of every docs page, so an AI-native user can drive generation programmatically. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), and no independent hands-on corroboration of the first-party API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
